skill_name: Come up with a creative activity that uses at least 5 elements of art (line, shape, texture, size, and color).
workflow: Create your own abstract artwork using the 5 elements of art: line, shape, texture, size, and color. Begin by cutting out a variety of shapes in different sizes from different colors of construction or craft papers. Experiment with each shape and texture by running them through a crimper or by tearing/shredding them.
